The default UNIX username on provisioned:
The default UNIX username on provisioned servers is being renamed from `launcher` to `captain`. This update renames the system user, moves the home directory, and updates all related configuration files (Caddyfile, systemd services, crontab) on your servers.

This is a safe, idempotent operation — if a server already has the `captain` user, it will be skipped automatically.
